# `user-posts` JSON output

The JSON document produced by the user-posts command after collection starts.

## UserPostsOutput

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `conditions` | [`UserPostsConditions`](#userpostsconditions) | true | The effective collection conditions. |
| `incomplete_reason` | string (`authentication_or_access_denied`, `rate_limited`, `api_error`, `request_failed`) | false | Why collection stopped early. Present only when status is incomplete. |
| `post_count` | integer | true | Number of posts retained; equals the length of posts. |
| `posts` | array of [`UserPost`](#userpost) | true | Posts returned by X, including posts without external links. Always an array. |
| `retrieved_at` | string | true | UTC time at which this collection run started. |
| `status` | string (`complete`, `limit_reached`, `incomplete`) | true | Whether the available pages were exhausted, the CLI limit stopped collection, or an error stopped collection. |
| `target_user` | [`TargetUser`](#targetuser) | true | The requested X user and, after successful resolution, their upstream identity. |

## TargetUser

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `id` | string | false | Upstream user identifier; omitted when username resolution failed. |
| `name` | string | false | Upstream display name; omitted when username resolution failed. |
| `username` | string | true | Username requested by the caller, normalized without a leading @ after resolution. |

## UserPost

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `created_at` | string | true | Upstream created_at value; empty if X omits it. |
| `id` | string | true | Upstream X post identifier. |
| `text` | string | true | Long-form text when supplied by X, otherwise the regular post text. |
| `url` | string | true | Canonical x.com URL for the post. |

## UserPostsConditions

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `end_time` | string | true | RFC 3339 exclusive upper time bound sent to X. |
| `exclude_replies` | boolean | true | Whether replies were excluded. |
| `exclude_reposts` | boolean | true | Whether reposts were excluded. |
| `limit` | integer | true | Maximum number of posts retained by the CLI. |
| `start_time` | string | true | RFC 3339 inclusive lower time bound sent to X. |
